notes:
Nexus 2.3.2: Race mode fixes

- Race remembers now: every message you send continues the same race with the same two AIs, instead of starting a brand-new race with AIs that forgot your task. A new race starts only after you apply a result or discard both.
- ChatGPT (Codex) can use Roblox Studio and other connected tools: its requests now come to your Permissions inbox (or are allowed automatically with Full access). Before, Nexus silently said no, which is why it said "Studio blocked".
- Each AI is told it's in a race, that its folder is its own copy, and that Roblox Studio is shared: it only changes the place you gave it, and asks once if you didn't say.
